Sauna Rental

SaimniekaPirts is a relaxing countryside getaway near Riga – for friends, families and informal business get-togethers.

White Sauna

A sauna with spacious rooms indoors and out – perfect for larger groups and celebrations with friends.

  • Relaxation Room Scented with Dried Herbs
  • Two-Storey Sauna House
  • Herbal Hot Tub Available as an Extra

Grey Sauna

A sauna designed by the sauna master himself, best suited to more experienced sauna lovers, in a separate building with a kitchen.

  • Sauna Designed by the Sauna Master
  • Relaxation Room with a Kitchenette
  • Herbal Hot Tub Available as an Extra

Herbal Hot Tubs

You can add the herbal hot tub to your booking. It is filled with medicinal herbs and leaves that relax the muscles, are good for the skin and help the body recover.
